note: Local paths on this machine. Adding a process node is an edit to this file plus `sync.py --to <repo>` and a flow_policy.json in the new repo.

skip.drcloop/: This port reads its PVS/Pegasus results through its own analog/layout/drc_db.py, imported by atlas.py, lyrdb.py, report.py and two test modules. Adopting the shared core is a MIGRATION of five import sites plus re-verification, not a delivery -- and the shared parser was PROVEN on this port's own five PVS databases, so the algorithms already agree. Re-open when someone owns the migration.

consumers.name: spec2si-seeqc
consumers.node: SeeQC superconducting SFQ (Nb; QC20uA Rev12, other SeeQC variants in the same repo)

skip.irdrop/: Superconducting Nb lines carry DC without drop: the bias-network drop sits in the bias resistors and is computed by the port's own bias allocators, and irdrop/currents.py reads Spectre operating points while SFQ bias currents come from JoSIM. Re-open when a bias-network IR model needs the shared solver.
skip.routekit/: PTL routing runs through Innovus at a stripline non-default rule, audited by the port's own DEF check (scripts/ptl_pnr_assemble.py); the routekit card schema is a CMOS back-end stack. Re-open if PTL route audits move to a shared card.
skip.housekeeping/: The sweep walks ~/Documents/*/analog/work and CMOS tool-output patterns; this port keeps cluster work under ~/Documents/seeqc-ads-pdk/<flow> and manages simulation scratch with its own lease/archive/receipt lifecycle (docs/simulation-scratch-cleanup.md).

renamed: ADR-0001: all five repos are spec2si-* as of 2026-08-24, LOCAL DIRECTORY AND GITHUB REMOTE alike -- AIML_ASIC -> spec2si-tsmc65, ONR_ADFT_ASIC -> spec2si-tsmc28, XT011_ASIC -> spec2si-xt011, SPEC2SI_FLOWKIT -> spec2si-flowkit, with spec2si-sky130 added under the convention. GitHub redirects the old names, so a stale clone keeps working; `git remote -v` should nonetheless read spec2si-* everywhere and disagreeing with this file is now DRIFT, not the expected state it was while the remotes lagged. Standing rule: record where a repo IS, never where it is going -- an intended path makes --check-all report MISSING on a healthy repo.
